definitions.gloss: poor work; bad piece; flop; mediocre creation
definitions.explanation: A piece of art, writing, film, or other creative work that is considered to be of low quality.

examples.japanese: あの{映画|えいが}は{駄作|ださく}だった。
{名監督|めいかんとく}にも{駄作|ださく}はある。
examples.english: Even great directors have some bad works.

examples.japanese: {期待|きたい}していたのに{駄作|ださく}で、{時間|じかん}の{無駄|むだ}だった。
examples.english: I had high expectations, but it was terrible and a waste of time.

notes:
USAGE:
A blunt, critical term used in reviews and casual conversation about creative works. The antonym is {傑作|けっさく} (masterpiece) or {名作|めいさく} (classic work).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駄作|ださく}{揃|ぞろ}い (nothing but bad works)
- {歴史的|れきしてき}{駄作|ださく} (a historically bad work)
- {駄作|ださく}と{名作|めいさく} (bad works and masterpieces)
